name: Univastu India Ltd
tagline: Small-cap construction/engineering (EPC-type) company with decent growth (~27%/yr) and a cheap P/E (~12x), but low-moat EPC economics and sharply worsening debtor days (58 -> 121) temper the case.
business_overview: Univastu India Ltd operates in the construction & engineering (EPC-type) space. Revenues have grown at an average ~26.8%/year, with ROE ~19.3% and net margins ~7.4%, but debtor days have roughly doubled (58.4 -> 121), a working-capital caution flag for a contracting-type business. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@rishithegreat41, high conviction claimed).
fundamentals_narrative: The growth (~27%/yr) and valuation (~12x P/E, ~19% ROE) combination looks statistically cheap for the growth rate. But construction/EPC-type businesses are typically low-moat and working-capital intensive, and the near-doubling of debtor days (58 -> 121) is a real caution: it suggests either slower client payment cycles, revenue recognition running ahead of cash collection, or increasing exposure to weaker-paying clients - any of which can turn a 'cheap growth' story into a cash-flow problem. Not a red flag on its own (no going-concern, fraud, or promoter-pledge signal found), but enough to keep this from a straightforward growth-compounder label.
